title: Epistle prepositional architecture
subtitle: Read how phrases locate source, sphere, means, and goal.
overview: Dense epistle sentences often layer prepositional phrases. Each phrase must be attached and its case observed before it is interpreted.
Do not compress distinct relations into a generic “in.” Let ἐκ, διά, ἐν, εἰς, and πρός retain their contextual work.

items.grc: ἐξ αὐτοῦ καὶ δι᾽ αὐτοῦ καὶ εἰς αὐτὸν τὰ πάντα.
items.en: From him and through him and to him are all things.

items.grc: ἐν αὐτῷ κατοικεῖ πᾶν τὸ πλήρωμα.
items.en: In him all the fullness dwells.
